hints.title: Shortest Path Exploration
hints.text: Search the directed network starting from source node 0 using edge transit durations as non-negative weights.

hints.title: Relaxation Order
hints.text: Always expand the vertex with the earliest confirmed arrival time to ensure optimal progression.

hints.title: Destination Check
hints.text: Return the arrival time immediately when the target destination node n minus one is visited.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: V: number of nodes in graph
complexity.notes: Standard shortest path search with min-priority queue over non-negative weights.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unordered graph exploration or Bellman-Ford wastes redundant iterations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Distance array of size V tracks minimal confirmed travel durations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply Dijkstra algorithm on non-negative weighted directed graphs.
